passive.name: Ionian Fervor
passive.text: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.

spells.name: Bladesurge
spells.text: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself. If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.

spells.name: Defiant Dance
spells.text: Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.

spells.name: Flawless Duet
spells.text: Irelia sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.

spells.name: Vanguard's Edge
spells.text: Irelia fires a massive number of blades that explode outward upon hitting an enemy champion. Enemies hit by the blades are damaged and Marked. Afterwards the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it.

damage.value: Irelia deals sustained AD damage through attacks empowered by her stacked passive.

archetype.value: Irelia is an AD bruiser and split pusher who uses minion waves to set up mechanical outplays.

axis.value: Irelia manipulates the wave, stacks her passive, and looks for an all-in.

winCondition.value: Irelia wins through relentless sidelane pressure and well-executed teamfights.

spikes.why: Irelia gains the attack speed to make her all-in more dangerous.
Irelia gains attack speed that makes her more dangerous in a fight.
Irelia gains bonus on-hit damage in addition to her stacking Attack Speed.

bait.why: Irelia loses her dash and its healing while Bladesurge is on cooldown, unless it refreshed.

mistakes.value: Irelia players make a mistake when they fight without passive stacks.
Irelia gives up a Bladesurge cooldown refresh when she uses it on a target that is neither Marked nor killed by the strike.
